test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which national park was declared India’s 58th Tiger Reserve in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhav National Park, Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Madhav National Park**, located in the **Shivpuri** district of **Madhya Pradesh**, was officially designated as India’s **58th Tiger Reserve** in **March 2025**.
 
• The notification was issued by the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)** following the final approval from the **National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA)**.
 
• This declaration makes **Madhya Pradesh** the state with the highest number of tiger reserves in India, bringing its total count to **8** (including Kanha, Bandhavgarh, Panna, Pench, Satpura, Sanjay-Dubri, and Veerangana Durgavati).
 
• The initiative is part of a broader conservation strategy to reintroduce and stabilize tiger populations in the **Gwalior-Chambal** region and create a functional wildlife corridor connecting **Ranthambore Tiger Reserve** in **Rajasthan** with **Kuno National Park** and **Madhav National Park**.
 
• Historically, **Madhav National Park** was the shooting reserve of the **Maharajas of Gwalior**; it was granted the status of a **National Park** in **1958**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Madhav National Park, Madhya Pradesh.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Project Tiger:**
 
 
• Launched on **April 1, 1973**, from **Jim Corbett National Park**, it is a centrally sponsored scheme aimed at ensuring a viable population of **Bengal Tigers** in their natural habitats.
 
• The project has expanded from an initial **9 reserves** to **58 reserves** as of **2025**, covering over **2%** of India's geographical area.
 
 
 
• **National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA):**
 
 
• The **NTCA** is a statutory body under the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change**, constituted under the enabling provisions of the **Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972**, as amended in **2006**.
 
• It provides statutory authority to **Project Tiger** and oversees the management and protection of tiger reserves across various states.
 
 
 
• **Tiger Census in India:**
 
 
• India conducts a nationwide **Tiger Census** every **four years** using the **M-STrIPES** (Monitoring System for Tigers - Intensive Protection and Ecological Status) application.
 
• According to the **2022 Tiger Census**, India is home to approximately **3,682 tigers**, which constitutes about **75%** of the global wild tiger population.
 
 
 
• **Geography of Madhav National Park:**
 
 
• The park is situated in the **Vindhyan Hills** and features a diverse ecosystem consisting of **dry deciduous forests** and flat grasslands.
 
• It is home to the **Sakhya Sagar** and **Madhav Sagar** lakes, which are designated **Ramsar Sites**, providing a crucial habitat for migratory birds and crocodiles.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Status of Other Options:**
 
 
• **Ramgarh Vishdhari National Park** (Rajasthan) was notified as India's **52nd Tiger Reserve** in **May 2022**.
 
• **Orang National Park** (Assam) was declared a tiger reserve in **2016**, becoming the **49th** in the country.
 
• **Guru Ghasidas National Park** (Chhattisgarh) and **Tamor Pingla Wildlife Sanctuary** were combined to be declared the **56th Tiger Reserve** in late **2024**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Notification:**
 
 
• Being declared a **Tiger Reserve** allows the park to receive dedicated funding and specialized protection forces under **Project Tiger**, enhancing anti-poaching measures and habitat management.
